title: Customer Retention Questioning
description: An original questioning exercise with a deterministic authored rubric.

questioningPrompts.title: Northline Software Churn
questioningPrompts.situation: Northline Software has seen monthly customer churn rise from 2% to 5% in six months, with the largest increase among smaller customers.
questioningPrompts.objective: Ask diagnostic questions that identify where and why customer churn increased.

intents.label: Churn pattern
intents.feedback: Locate the increase by customer segment and time period.
referenceQuestions: When did churn begin to rise, and which customer segments account for the increase?

intents.label: Product value and usage
intents.feedback: Compare adoption and engagement between retained and lost customers.
referenceQuestions: How do product usage and feature adoption differ for retained and churned customers?

intents.label: Pricing and contracts
intents.feedback: Test whether price, packaging, or contract changes affected churn.
referenceQuestions: Did pricing, packaging, or contract terms change before churn increased?

intents.label: Onboarding and support
intents.feedback: Investigate onboarding quality and customer-support performance.
referenceQuestions: Did onboarding, support response time, or customer-success coverage deteriorate?
